## TRA Timeline

#### De-SPAC and TRA execution

- 2021-03-22: Form-of TRA filed as Exhibit 10.15 to the S-4 by Spartan Acquisition Corp. II
- 2021-07-09: Business combination with Sunlight Financial LLC closed; executed TRA filed as Exhibit 10.13 to the closing 8-K

#### Prepackaged Chapter 11 and TRA termination

- 2023-10-30: Terminating amendment to the TRA executed in tandem with the Restructuring Support Agreement and Investment Agreement with ED Umbrella Holdings; prepackaged Chapter 11 petition filed in the Bankruptcy Court for the District of Delaware (Case No. 23-11794)
- 2023-12-06: Plan Effective Date reached; TRA terminated in its entirety with no party retaining any rights, benefits, or obligations

## Explanation

Sunlight Financial Holdings Inc. (formerly Spartan Acquisition Corp. II) executed this TRA on July 9, 2021 at the closing of its de-SPAC Up-C business combination with Sunlight Financial LLC, agreeing to pay 85% of net cash tax savings from Section 754 basis step-ups generated by future Redemptions of Class EX Units. The TRA accrued only a trivial $0.1M liability through its life because Sunlight remained loss-making; only one Class EX unit exchange occurred (in 2022) and no TRA payments were ever made. The TRA was extinguished on December 6, 2023 (the Plan Effective Date of Sunlight's prepackaged Chapter 11) via a terminating amendment executed October 30, 2023 alongside the Restructuring Support Agreement; the TRA Holders received no payment and explicitly acknowledged foregoing substantial economic benefits in exchange for the releases granted under the Plan. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
